title.zh: 快捷唤起 · DeepSeek Harness 插件

description.en: A system-wide hotkey for DeepSeek Harness on macOS: press it to open a lightweight always-on-top quick-input popup with workspace, model and reasoning-effort pickers; the main window shows the answer.
description.zh: macOS 上的 DeepSeek Harness 系统级全局快捷键插件：按下即弹出轻量置顶输入框，可切换工作区/模型/思考强度，回车后主窗口展示答案。

description.en: Global hotkey (⌘⇧Space) opens a lightweight always-on-top input popup with workspace, model and reasoning-effort pickers. Enter raises the main window and streams the answer. In-app ⌘⇧K overlay adds image paste and file attachments.
description.zh: 全局快捷键（⌘⇧Space）弹出轻量置顶输入框，带工作区/模型/思考强度下拉；回车后主窗口到前台并流式输出答案。窗口内 ⌘⇧K 浮层还支持粘图与附加文件。
